q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: WITH ranked_drinkers AS (SELECT f.bar, f.drinker, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.bar ORDER BY f.times_a_week DESC) AS rank FROM frequents AS f) SELECT f1.bar, SUM(f1.times_a_week) AS total_times_a_week, AVG(s1.price) AS average_beers_price, rd.drinker AS most_frequent_drinker FROM frequents AS f1 JOIN serves AS s1 ON f1.bar = s1.bar JOIN ranked_drinkers AS rd ON f1.bar = rd.bar AND rd.rank = 1 GROUP BY f1.bar, rd.drinker
